title: Inefficient query
summary: A frequent front-desk lookup by the numeric part of the MRN. The problem variant wraps the indexed column in RIGHT(), so uq_patients_mrn can't be seeked and every call scans care.patients: modest cost per call, high cost in total because it runs constantly. The healthy variant compares the full MRN and seeks, for a Query Store before-and-after comparison.

intensity.description: Pace: about 2 lookups per second per session at 1, back to back at 10.

expectedHubSignals.signal: SqlServerCPUUtilization and Batch Requests/sec above the baseline
An inefficient-query finding that names the non-SARGable predicate
expectedHubSignals.note: Preview; coverage by target is undocumented (ADR 0013).

expectedSymptoms: One lookup dominates total CPU and logical reads through sheer execution count
Its plan scans care.patients although an index on mrn exists
variant=healthy keeps the same execution rate with a fraction of the reads
queryLevelEvidence: Query Store: top queries by total logical reads and execution count; compare the problem and healthy query texts
The plan: Clustered Index Scan on care.patients with a RIGHT() predicate
